# SELFMADE

> Printable planners (PDF), workbooks and free browser tools for budgets, bills, tax set-aside, meal planning, habits and getting organised. Every PDF has a free sample; every tool has a free version that does not expire.

Key facts:
- Printable PDFs are a one-time payment, downloaded immediately. Bundles cost 10% less than the same PDFs bought separately.
- Browser tools are free to use with a limit. Pro is an optional monthly subscription, cancellable from the account at any time.
- Anything typed into a tool stays in the visitor's own browser and is not uploaded.
- Refunds: within 30 days if a product is not what its page described.
- Contact: selfmade.engine@gmail.com

## Collections

- [Freelancers & the self-employed](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/freelancers/): When you work for yourself, nobody takes the tax out before the money reaches you, nobody chases the invoice, and nobody tells you what to charge.
- [Trades](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/trades/): Built for people who are on a job all day and do the paperwork on the sofa at night.
- [Parents & families](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/parents/): A household runs on a dozen small lists that live in one person's head.
- [Couples & shared homes](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/couples/): Two people, one home, and a running question of who paid for what.
- [Students](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/students/): Term time is deadlines, a loan that arrives in lumps, and food that has to last until the next one.
- [Teachers](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/teachers/): For the part of teaching nobody sees: the planning on Sunday, the reading log, the goals set in September and found again in March.
- [Shift & hourly workers](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/shift-workers/): When your hours change every week, so does your pay.
- [Shops, cafés & salons](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/small-business/): For businesses small enough that the owner is also the rota, the stockroom and the accounts.
- [Drivers & mobile work](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/drivers/): If the vehicle is the business, fuel, insurance and wear come out of every pound you take.
- [Founders, marketers & site owners](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/for/makers/): The small jobs that come round every time you ship something: tag a campaign link so the visit can be traced, write the meta tags that decide how a page looks when it is shared, turn a draft into clean HTML, and work out a price that covers its costs.
- [Budget, bills & debt](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/budget-and-bills/): Everything here answers one of three questions: where does the money go, will it last until payday, and when will the debt be gone.
- [Tax, pricing & getting paid](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/tax-and-getting-paid/): The money side of working for yourself, or of being paid by the hour: what to charge, what to put aside, whether the job made a profit and whether the payslip was right.
- [Meal planning](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/meal-planning/): A week of dinners decided once, with the shopping list written from it.
- [Habits & mindset](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/habits-and-mindset/): Two kinds of thing live here.
- [Weekly & goal planners](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/planners/): Plain, printable pages for running a week: what is on, what matters, what can wait.
- [Simple, uncluttered planners](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/simple-planners/): Some planners are so busy that filling them in becomes the chore.
- [All printable planners](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/printables/): Every printable planner in the shop.
- [Workbooks & guides](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/workbooks/): Longer than a planner and meant to be worked through once: short chapters, then pages that ask you questions and leave room for the answers.
- [Bundles](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/bundles/): Related PDFs sold together for 10% less than their separate prices.
- [All free tools](https://selfmade-engine.github.io/selfmade-site/shop/free-tools/): Calculators and trackers that run in your browser.
